purpose: Requirements for the agenda record layer, a single source of truth holding agenda items and their states so humans can grasp the whole and respond individually while minimizing AI effort on record upkeep.
summary: Rationale: the mechanism exists only to reduce AI output and reading effort spent maintaining records
Terminology: agenda item, agenda, record, presentation, caller; the word triage is not used
Scope: record and state keeping, transition checks, caller input/output, location/count/lifetime, discarding old records
FNC-004 to FNC-006: AI generates only judgment content, input is one structured handoff of one value, next action is returned without counting
FNC-008: transition preconditions are machine-readable and unmet transitions are rejected with the shortfall identifiable
FNC-009: record count, identification, lifetime, severity key, and state vocabulary are received from the caller
FNC-012: the caller judges structural validity of the whole item set first; item transitions are rejected until recorded
FNC-013 and FNC-010: retain change information for the display layer; discard legacy review and consult records
NFR-001 to NFR-006: storage format owns value boundaries, derived location and lifetime, unit tests, no secret values, visible failures
Open items TBD-003, TBD-004, TBD-006 with resolutions
tasks: Implementing agenda record storage and state transitions
Writing unit tests for the agenda mechanism
Integrating consult or review skills with the agenda
Reviewing agenda requirements or design documents
Choosing a storage format for work records
title: REQ-019 議事記録機構 要件定義書
